semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while the agency supports semiconductor-related businesses, it primarily functions as a facilitator for Polish companies rather than a direct supplier.
summary: The Polish Investment and Trade Agency (PAIH) promotes the growth of the Polish semiconductor and microelectronics sectors by assisting local businesses in expanding internationally and attracting foreign direct investment. They provide support in navigating administrative processes, finding partners, and developing export strategies.
capabilities: Support for foreign expansion of Polish semiconductor businesses
Facilitation of joint projects and R&D partnerships
Assistance in overcoming legal and administrative hurdles for semiconductor firms

regional_presence.Poland: The agency actively supports the growth and internationalization of the Polish semiconductor industry.
